description: The CI actions pinned in .forgejo/workflows are tracked by the built-in github-actions manager, which already matches .forgejo and .gitea workflows and understands both 'owner/repo@v1' and full-URL 'https://github.com/owner/repo@v1' refs. No customManagers are needed.

packageRules.description: Group Nix flake input updates into a single PR
Group non-major CI action updates in .forgejo/workflows; major bumps get their own PR
